title: Kinematic and structural analysis of the Minispiral in the Galactic Center from BEAR spectro-imagery

evidence.locator: Abstract: the Northern Arm is not only the bright narrow north-south lane of intensity images but a faint, continuous, triangular surface, drawn out into a narrow stream near Sgr A*, with a bright western rim; a system of Keplerian orbits fits most of it. Sect. 5.4: the orbits are not quite coplanar, their planes varying over about 10°. Sect. 5.5: the model is published as four FITS files, the first giving the distance to the observer at each point of the field.
